# sectui NUR

> A [NUR](https://github.com/nix-community/NUR) repository for the [sectui](https://github.com/sectui) security tools.

## Packages

## Usage

### With NUR

```nix
environment.systemPackages = [
  pkgs.nur.repos.sectui.subdomain-finder
];
```

### With flakes

```nix
{
  inputs.nur-sectui.url = "github:sectui/nur";

  outputs = { nixpkgs, nur-sectui, ... }: {
    # in a NixOS module:
    environment.systemPackages = [
      nur-sectui.packages.${system}.subdomain-finder
    ];
  };
}
```

Or run a tool without installing it:

```sh
nix run github:sectui/nur#subdomain-finder -- example.com
```

### Overlay

```nix
nixpkgs.overlays = [ nur-sectui.overlays.default ];
# then pkgs.subdomain-finder
```
